items.source: #{"#n1ql.bucket". bucket will be replaced by (escaped) bucket name in which the entity is stored.
items.translation: #{"#n1ql.bucket".bucket} 将被替换为存储该实体的（转义后的）桶名称。

items.source: #{"#n1ql.collection". bucket will be replaced by (escaped) collection name in which the entity is stored.
items.translation: #{"#n1ql.collection".bucket 将被替换为存储该实体的（转义后的）集合名称。

items.source: #{"#n1ql.delete"}. delete will be replaced by a delete expression.
items.translation: #{"#n1ql.delete"}. delete 将被替换为删除表达式。

items.source: #{"#n1ql.fields". fields will be replaced by the list of N1QL fields allowing to reconstruct the entity.
items.translation: #{"#n1ql.fields". fields 将被替换为允许重建实体的 N1QL 字段列表。

items.source: #{"#n1ql.filter"}. filter will be replaced by an expression allowing to select only entries matching the entity in a WHERE clause.
items.translation: #{"#n1ql.filter"}.filter 将被替换为一个表达式，用于在 WHERE 子句中仅选择与实体匹配的条目。

items.source: #{"#n1ql.returning"}. returning will be replaced by a returning expression allowing to return the entity and meta information on deletes.
items.translation: #{"#n1ql.returning"}.returning 将被一个 returning 表达式替换，该表达式允许在删除操作时返回实体和元信息。

items.source: #{"#n1ql.scope". bucket will be replaced by (escaped) scope name in which the entity is stored.
items.translation: #{"#n1ql.scope".bucket 将被替换为存储该实体的（转义）作用域名称。

items.source: This class is exposed to SpEL parsing through the variable #"n1ql". Use the attributes in your SpEL expressions: selectEntity, fields, bucket and filter.
items.translation: 该类通过变量 `#"n1ql"` 暴露给 SpEL 解析器。请在您的 SpEL 表达式中使用以下属性：selectEntity、fields、bucket 和 filter。

items.source: #{"#n1ql.selectEntity". selectEntity will be replaced by the SELECT-FROM clause corresponding to the entity.
items.translation: `#{"#n1ql.selectEntity".selectEntity}` 将被替换为与该实体对应的 SELECT-FROM 子句。

items.source: #{"#n1ql.selectEntity". selectEntity will be replaced by the SELECT-FROM clause corresponding to the entity. Use once at the beginning.
items.translation: #{"#n1ql.selectEntity".selectEntity} 将被替换为与该实体对应的 SELECT-FROM 子句。仅在开头使用一次。

items.source: Subhashni Balakrishnan, Michael Reiche, Tigran Babloyan
